expectations.text: First step is writing a failing test, not implementation code
expectations.evidence: Step 1 explicitly titled 'Write the first failing test (RED)' — opens test file first, states 'The Iron Law applies: no production code without a failing test first'

expectations.text: Specifies running the test to verify it fails before implementing
expectations.evidence: Step 2 'Verify the test fails for the right reason (Verify RED)' — includes exact command and expected failure output 'expected exit code 0, got 1'

expectations.text: Implementation step comes AFTER test verification step
expectations.evidence: Step 3 'Write minimal implementation (GREEN)' comes after Step 2 verification. Explicitly says 'Only now open scripts/state-write.sh'

expectations.text: Includes a step to verify tests pass after implementation
expectations.evidence: Step 4 'Verify the test passes (Verify GREEN)' with exact command, plus full regression run: 'All previously passing tests must still pass'

expectations.text: Does not add features beyond what was requested (no over-engineering)
expectations.evidence: Implementation is minimal: 3 small changes. Explicitly states 'Nothing else changes. No new abstractions, no refactoring other code.'
